Third-party files bundled with Nemvo Email, so that browsers load nothing
from a CDN or any other site. Unmodified copies of the published packages.

chart/chart.umd.min.js   chart.js 4.6.1   MIT   https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js/tree/v4.6.1
                         (dist/chart.umd.min.js of the npm package
                         https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js/v/4.6.1; the readable
                         source is src/ at that tag, and dist/chart.umd.js in the package)

License texts are in the LICENSE-*.txt files next to each component.
